title: Launch a coin. Its fees pay an AI to build its game.
blurb: Every coin on Fee2Play gets its own browser game, built live by AI and paid for by its trading fees.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Every coin on Fee2Play comes with its own browser game.

Its trading fees pay an AI to build it, live, in front of everyone.

Pick a game

Endless runner, flyer, snake, space shooter, tower stacker. Or pitch your own idea in one line.

Name the coin and launch it with one signature.

Fees fund it

80% of each trading fee goes to the game's fund. 20% goes to Fee2Play. The split is locked on pump.fun itself, so nobody can change it.

When the fund hits $20 the AI starts building, and the fees that keep coming in keep making the game better.

Watch it get built

The agent works in the open on the coin's page, step by step. Only the wallet that launched the coin can steer it.

Anyone can play the game right there in the browser.

Every coin is a game.

Launch yours on fee2play.fun

What game would your coin be? Tell me below.
